description: A delicious 3-day food trip to Tokyo, exploring street food, local markets, and hands-on cooking experiences.

accommodation.amenities: restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival and Ginza Street Food
days.description: Arrive in Tokyo and immediately dive into the vibrant street food scene of Ginza.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll explore the bustling streets and hidden alleys of Ginza.What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and an appetite.What to eat: A variety of local street food delicacies.Good to know: This tour is a great introduction to Tokyo's culinary landscape.

days.title: Cooking Class and Shibuya Night Market
days.description: Learn to cook Japanese dishes with a local chef, then experience the lively Shibuya night market.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: A local kitchen setting and traditional Japanese ingredients.What to bring: Your enthusiasm for cooking and learning.What to eat: Dishes you prepare yourself, showcasing authentic Japanese flavors.Good to know: This class offers a hands-on cultural experience.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Night Market & Tapas Crawl — Evening Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: The vibrant atmosphere of a Tokyo night market and various food stalls.What to bring: Cash for small purchases and an open mind for new tastes.What to eat: A selection of Japanese tapas and street food.Good to know: This is a great way to experience Tokyo's nightlife and casual dining.

days.title: Ueno Cooking Class and Departure
days.description: Enjoy a final cooking class in Ueno before heading to the airport for your departure.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef
activities.notes: What you'll see: A traditional Japanese cooking environment.What to bring: A camera to capture your culinary creations.What to eat: Delicious Japanese dishes prepared by you.Good to know: This class provides insight into Japanese home cooking.
